prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a slow, steady movement forward along a snowy trail under the night sky. The camera captures the gentle descent of snowflakes, which softly illuminate against the dark backdrop, creating a serene and quiet atmosphere. As the viewer progresses, the path winds through a rugged terrain dotted with rocks and sparse vegetation, all blanketed in a layer of fresh snow. The camera angle remains at eye level, providing an immersive experience of navigating the trail. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, with only faint ambient light revealing the contours of the landscape. The trees, mostly leafless and silhouetted against the night, occasionally sway slightly in the breeze. The ground beneath is uneven, with patches of exposed earth peeking through the snow. The camera continues its forward motion, subtly adjusting to the undulating terrain, maintaining a consistent pace that emphasizes the isolation and tranquility of the Mardi Himal Trail in Kaski, Nepal, during a snowy night. The overall scene is devoid of any human presence, enhancing the sense of solitude and natural beauty.
